title: Ongoing Strength in China's Renewables
summary:
Main
By Jeffrey Landsberg
As we discussed in Commodore Research's most recent Weekly China Report, Chinese electricity production set a record last month. Electricity production totaled a record 943.9 billion kilowatt hours, which is up year-on-year by 2%. Of note, though, is that thermal coal-derived electricity generation contracted year-on-year by 3%.
